Image Posterize

Reduce any image to 2–8 colors per channel for a bold retro posterized look.

🖼️ Drop an image here or click to browse

Files never leave your device — everything is processed in your browser.

📖 How to use

  1. Drop an image into the tool.
  2. Drag the levels slider (2–8) to preview.
  3. Click Download PNG to save it.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What is posterization?

Color quantization: each channel is snapped to the nearest of N evenly spaced levels (N = 2 to 8).

Which level should I pick?

Fewer levels = flatter, more graphic blocks of color. Try 3–4 for a classic poster look.

What format is the download?

A lossless PNG at the original dimensions.
